scripts.build: python3 ../../../../shared/ui/scripts/check-theme.py && tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck:installer && vite build
scripts.test: node --test ../../../../shared/ui/test/contracts.cjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s ../../../../shared/ui/test -p "test_*.py" && node --test tests/*.test.cjs tests/connect/*.test.cjs tests/notes/*.test.cjs tests/installer/*.test.ts
scripts.test:electron: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/electron-smoke.cjs tests/storage-smoke.cjs tests/connect/smoke.cjs tests/retention-smoke.cjs tests/appearance/smoke.cjs tests/notes/smoke.cjs tests/installer/smoke.ts
scripts.typecheck:installer: tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --strict electron/installer/main.cts electron/installer/preload.cts
